policy.why: Keep v2.0.0 as the reproducible before-picture. All modernization is additive overlay so a reviewer can still run the inherited estate.

leverage.use: Evidence and KPI baselines; never cleaned to look consistent
Before-counts for identity, inventory, task, maintenance, safety, telemetry
Control path: trusts WMS quantity only
Document inherited defects; remain XFAIL on baseline
must_not rules become the eval harness (T06)
Resilience traces without building a new simulator from scratch
Observe-only surface; overlay does not issue control commands
Human workarounds (cutoff, camera 18, Dock 7, AMR-044) as first-class inputs

transformations.name: Canonical robot identity
transformations.invariant: One physical robot maps to many aliases; assignment uses canonical robot_id, never a colliding alias alone.
transformations.eval: EVAL-006 must_not pick a source solely by system name

transformations.name: Inventory physical/digital reconciliation
transformations.invariant: When WMS, ERP, and vision disagree, surface uncertainty; do not invent physical truth.

transformations.name: Contradiction observability layer
transformations.invariant: Baseline diagnostic counts remain reproducible on frozen v2.0.0 data.

transformations.name: Robot suitability gate (workflow 1: assignment)
transformations.invariant: Expired safety cert, open CMMS, or payload mismatch => not assignable even if fleet AVAILABLE.
transformations.eval: EVAL-002; new tests beside XFAIL legacy tests

transformations.name: Task/order exception and cutoff workflow (workflow 3)
transformations.invariant: WES status and fleet status are distinct clocks; OMS SLA may be stale vs shadow cutoff.
transformations.eval: EVAL-003 must_not assume business sequence from recorded_time

transformations.name: Eval / TEVV harness before autonomy
brief_outcomes: implement evals before any autonomous action
transformations.invariant: No overlay decision path ships without a matching must_not eval.

transformations.name: Resilience under two injects
brief_outcomes: demonstrate resilience under at least two injects
transformations.invariant: After outage, do not blindly replay stale fleet queue; never endorse safety-zone bypass to hit cutoff.

transformations.name: KPI delta and authority boundaries
transformations.invariant: Safety PLC, e-stop, and speed-limit changes stay human-gated. Overlay remains observe/recommend.

transformations.name: Global task prioritization (replace local battery heuristic)
transformations.invariant: Local robot score must not starve cutoff-critical waves.

transformations.name: Congestion and cutoff risk forecasting
transformations.invariant: Forecast is advisory; it cannot override safety gates in T04.

transformations.name: Bounded autonomy runtime beyond recommend
transformations.invariant: No physical control. Reversible low-risk automation only after T06 evals pass in production TEVV.
